description.tr: Benu Abbas'ın kendi zamanında seyyidi ve şeyhlerinin başı.
description.en: The master of the Banū al-ʿAbbās in his time and their chief elder.

transliteration.ar-Latn-x-alalc: Muhammad b. ʿAlī b. Muhammad b. ʿUbayd Allāh b. ʿAbd al-Samad, son of the Caliph al-Muhtadī bi-Allāh Muhammad b. al-Wāthiq al-ʿAbbāsī, Abū al-Ḥusayn al-Khaṭīb known as Ibn al-Ghārīq and Ibn al-Muhtadī

tr: Muhammed b. Alî b. Muhammed b. Ubeydillah b. Abdissamad İbn el-Halîfe el-Mehtedîbillâh Muhammed b. el-Vâsık el-Abbâsî, Ebû'l-Hüseyn el-Hatîb el-Meʿrûf bi İbn el-Garîk ve bi İbn el-Mehtedî
ar: محمد بن علي بن محمد بن عبيد الله بن عبد الصمد ابن الخليفة المهتديبالله محمد ابن الواثق العباسي، أبو الحسين الخطيب المعروف ب ابن الغريق وبابن المهتدي بالله
